event EscrowHeld(string indexed lotId, address indexed recycler, address indexed collector, uint256 amount)
event EscrowReleased(string indexed lotId, address indexed collector, uint256 amount, bytes32 proofHash)
event EscrowDisputed(string indexed lotId, address indexed raisedBy, string reason)
event EscrowResolved(string indexed lotId, address indexed payoutRecipient, uint256 payoutAmount)
function lockEscrow(string calldata lotId, address payable collector) external payable
function releaseEscrow(string calldata lotId, bytes32 proofHash) external
function freezeForDispute(string calldata lotId, string calldata reason) external
function resolveDispute(string calldata lotId, address payable payoutRecipient, uint256 payoutAmount) external
function getEscrow(string calldata lotId) external view returns (address collector, address recycler, uint256 amount, uint8 status, bytes32 handoverProofHash, uint256 heldAt, uint256 settledAt)
